snippet.title: PlayStation®5 / Steam® 『4PGP』4K LaunchTrailer
snippet.description:
90's arcade fun for everyone! 3goo Launches Arcade Racer 4PGP on PlayStation®5 and Steam®! 

-------------- 
■About “4PGP” Race Together! Share the excitement with friends and family playing split-screen multiplayer. Hop in a formula car and race on unique tracks from around the world. With its multiple difficulty settings and accessibility options such as an assist mode, 4PGP can be enjoyed by everyone from beginners to experts. 
On PlayStation®5 and Steam®, 4PGP has been enhanced with analogue acceleration and braking controls, allowing for more precise driving and advanced racing techniques. Players can also take advantage of new control options and button mapping features, including multiple control profiles on PlayStation®5 and customizable gamepad and keyboard controls on Steam®. 
4PGP also supports 4K resolution at 60 FPS with updated visual effects, delivering a smoother and more visually impressive racing experience. In addition, a brand-new unlockable vehicle, the SAFETY CAR, can be obtained by playing Quick Race in split-screen multiplayer. 

Steam® players can also enjoy racing with friends around the world through Remote Play Together. *The Nintendo Switch™ and Nintendo Switch™ 2 versions received a free update today that adds the same features and improvements.

▼Official Website： https://www.4pgp.com/en/ 
--------------

▼Click here to download
PlayStation™ Store(US):
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10018860

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3649530/4PGP/

--------------

Release Date: 2026.6.11 (Thu.)

Platform: PlayStation®5/STEAM®
Genre: Racing
Players: 1 to 4 players
Languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, German, French, Chinese (simplified/traditional), Korean, and Japanese
